# Soft Bridge FZE LLC

> UAE business infrastructure firm — company formation, banking preparation, residency, AML compliance, and digital growth for international founders.

Soft Bridge helps founders establish compliant, scalable businesses in the UAE across Mainland and 40+ Free Zones, with long-term operational support and a cinematic client portal.

## Services

- [Business Formation](/services/business-formation): Mainland & Free Zone company setup.
- [Banking Preparation](/services/banking-preparation): UAE corporate bank account opening support.
- [Residency & Relocation](/services/residency-relocation): Investor and employment visas.
- [Operational Support](/services/operational-support): Ongoing back-office, accounting, and compliance.
- [AML Compliance](/services/aml-compliance): Anti-money-laundering registration and reporting.
- [Web & Advertising](/services/web-advertising): Websites, branding, and paid acquisition.
- [UAE Formation Locations](/services/uae-company-formation-locations): All jurisdictions we operate in.

## Jurisdictions

- [Dubai](/dubai-company-formation): IFZA, DMCC, Meydan, JAFZA, DAFZA and Mainland.
- [Abu Dhabi](/abu-dhabi-company-formation): ADGM, Masdar, KIZAD and Mainland.
- [Sharjah](/sharjah-company-formation): SHAMS, SAIF Zone, Hamriyah and Mainland.
- [Ajman](/ajman-company-formation): Ajman Free Zone and Mainland.
- [Ras Al Khaimah](/rak-company-formation): RAKEZ and RAK ICC.
- [Fujairah](/fujairah-company-formation): Fujairah Free Zone and Creative City.
- [Umm Al Quwain](/uaq-company-formation): UAQ Free Trade Zone.
